instruction: find the {object} by turning your waist, without walking, then point at it with your right arm; if you cannot find it after looking around, say so and give up

object.note: what to point at, as the person named it (a water bottle, the red chair, the teacher's laptop)

safety_notes: Do not walk in this task: search with the waist and point with the right arm only.
notes: Point at whatever is asked: g1 start fills {object} from the request ("point at the water bottle": the model's run_task object, or /task point_at water bottle). g1 run point_at uses the default, the laptop, in point_at_the_laptop's scene, so --sim is scored by the twin as that task is. Robot: the object within the waist's reach of view (in front, up to about 90 degrees either side), not too far to see.
